axes_rationale.hook: The first reach-and-stop action is understandable with sound off. It has a specific human consequence and is not merely a title card.
axes_rationale.story: The award-term timing, conditional reach adjustment, simulated setting, future consent work, and absence of reported care results are separated responsibly. The ending returns to the opening reach problem.
axes_rationale.picture: The central mug mechanics work, with a readable release and changed reach. The window-opening room reveal adds little and the participation passage relies on labels while repeating a door opening across a discontinuous cut.
axes_rationale.place: Indoor research kit and ordinary civilian clothing are plausible for UT Austin in Travis County, with no regionally wrong vegetation, industrial PPE or retired motifs. The neutral room contains little distinctive local detail, so its county credibility remains adequate rather than strong.
axes_rationale.craft: High-contrast captions, visible hand/cup geometry, persistent illustration label and complete source/music credits survive a 390-pixel phone view. The floating door and abrupt open-to-closed reset weaken causal staging; several source-sheet entries briefly overlap the heading while travelling but settle legibly.
axes_rationale.voice: The exact transcript and measured cue boundaries support a usable timed narration. No direct listening was possible, so expressive performance is unverified and the comparatively quiet measured master remains a qualification on this score.
